description: Trees/foliage: restyle the three existing low-poly tree scenes into crafted 'game-piece' trees - soft-cel fill + subtle dark outline, foliage recolor variation that actually works, a soft contact shadow so each reads as a placed piece, and MultiMesh GPU instancing for performance - WITHOUT changing where trees are placed (that is generation). Builds on FEAT-001 (lighting) and FEAT-002 (board materials). The three tree scenes use imported vertex-color meshes with emission; the current hex_grid _apply_random_tree_colors() is a no-op (only touches CSGSphere3D) and must be rewritten.
steps: Author scripts/tree_toon.gdshader (shader_type spatial): flat 2-3 band soft-cel over a foliage_colour uniform, no emission; keep trunk brown (via vertex color or a second trunk material). Author scripts/tree_outline.gdshader: inverted-hull dark outline (render_mode cull_front; expand back faces along NORMAL by small outline_width in near-black navy ~#141d28), wired as a next_pass on the foliage material (or a duplicated slightly-scaled MeshInstance). Silhouettes must stay legible at the board camera angle (stacked-cone pine / faceted broadleaf / shrub shapes).

Apply the new materials to scenes/tiles/trees.tscn, trees-2.tscn, trees-3.tscn: replace/augment the embedded vertex-color StandardMaterial3D (remove emission_enabled=true), expose foliage_colour so recolor can vary it. Reuse/recolor/scale/rotate these few base shapes for variety (the brief allows new simple low-poly meshes only if they clearly help).

Rewrite hex_grid.gd::_apply_random_tree_colors() (~line 6800): walk MeshInstance3D children (not CSGSphere3D) and set the foliage_colour shader param (duplicate the ShaderMaterial per tree to avoid sharing) OR duplicate+tint the StandardMaterial albedo, using the muted-green variation palette already in tree_spawner.gd::foliage_colors. This makes foliage color variation actually take effect.

Soft contact shadow 'placed piece' read: prefer the real DirectionalLight3D shadow (now ON from FEAT-001); if it reads too weak at the camera angle, add a cheap faux shadow - a flattened dark semi-transparent disc (QuadMesh/PlaneMesh, unshaded radial-gradient alpha) parented at each tree base. Keep it cheap.

MultiMesh instancing in hex_grid.gd TREE loop (~line 6545): collect per-model transforms during the loop, then build one MultiMeshInstance3D per tree model for the VISUAL meshes, while keeping a per-cell lightweight StaticBody3D+CylinderShape3D collision (gameplay depends on tree collisions). Preserve the 'trees' group and the collision contract. Must NOT change tree PLACEMENT (count/cells/positions/offsets/scale-rotation ranges). If per-instance foliage_colour variation under MultiMesh proves unsafe to wire, fall back to instanced scenes but remove redundant per-tree work and RECORD the decision in findings.
Optional: if the FEAT-001 note deferred calming the textureFloor cloud shader, gently reduce its speed/contrast here so the backdrop reads as a calm board surround (do not remove it).
acceptance_criteria: Trees render as crafted soft-cel game pieces with a subtle dark outline and legible silhouettes at the board camera angle; no tree emission/glow.
Foliage color variation is visibly applied across trees (the rewritten _apply_random_tree_colors() affects the real meshes, not a no-op).
Each tree reads as sitting on its tile with a soft contact shadow (real directional shadow or faux disc).
Tree visuals are MultiMesh-instanced per model (or a documented fallback) and tree collisions still exist per cell.
Tree PLACEMENT is unchanged (same cells/positions/count; generation code paths for choosing cells untouched).

V1 no output; V2 no SCRIPT ERROR/parse error; V3 test_turn_loop 40/40 exit 0 (it asserts 'non-punch roll stops before TREE' and 'punch rolls THROUGH the tree' - tree collisions MUST survive instancing); V4 test_live_hand_wiring 16/16 exit 0.
verification: /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/artpass --quit-after 400 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|not found|null|invalid|nonexistent" | grep -viE "shader|vulkan|rendering device|headless"  (expect no output)

/Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --headless --path /Users/m22stewa/Documents/Godot/Golf/.worktrees/artpass scenes/tests/test_turn_loop.tscn 2>&1 | tail -3  (expect 40 checks, 0 failures; exit 0 - tree collision gate)
findings: Implemented MultiMesh GPU instancing for tree VISUALS (chosen path, no fallback needed). One MultiMeshInstance3D per tree model (trees/trees-2/trees-3) is built in hex_grid.gd::_generate_grid(); per-tree foliage colour variation rides safely as MultiMesh per-instance custom data (mm.use_custom_data=true + set_instance_custom_data), read in tree_toon.gdshader via INSTANCE_CUSTOM (rgb=tint, a=1 flags use; a=0 falls back to the foliage_colour uniform so the material still works for a standalone scene instance). Per-cell collisions were KEPT as lightweight StaticBody3D+CylinderShape3D nodes (one per TREE cell, in group 'trees') decoupled from the visual meshes; V3 test_turn_loop stayed 40/40 (non-punch roll stops before TREE, punch passes through). Placement is byte-for-byte unchanged (same cell scan, position jitter +/-0.2, random Y rot + ~5deg tilt, base_scale 1.5-2.5, height_scale 0.9-1.3); only the render path moved from one scene instance per cell to shared MultiMeshes, with each model's nested node-tree local transform (incl. the 0.2 scale node) folded into every instance transform. KEY DISCOVERY: the three imported tree meshes have NO vertex colour (surface format 34359742487 = VERTEX|NORMAL|TANGENT|TEX_UV, COLOR bit unset); colour comes from UV into the texture_gradient.png palette atlas, so tree_toon.gdshader samples albedo_texture by UV (not COLOR) and recolours only the green-dominant (foliage) bands, leaving the brown trunk bands untouched. Materials: new ShaderMaterial scenes/tiles/tree_foliage.tres (tree_toon.gdshader + tree_outline.gdshader inverted-hull next_pass, cull_front, navy ~#141d28), emission removed from all three tree scenes. Contact shadow: real DirectionalLight3D shadow is on (FEAT-001) AND a cheap faux radial-alpha disc (tree_shadow.gdshader, one shared QuadMesh, its own cast-shadow-off MultiMesh) sits under each tree so every tree reads as a placed piece. _apply_random_tree_colors() rewritten from the CSGSphere3D no-op to walk MeshInstance3D children, duplicate the ShaderMaterial per tree, and set foliage_colour (functional recolor path for standalone scene instances). Verified: V1 no output, V2 no SCRIPT ERROR/parse error, V3 40/40 exit 0, V4 16/16 exit 0; windowed capture confirms soft-cel pieces with dark outlines, visible green variation, contact shadows, no emission, unchanged framing. Step 6 (calm textureFloor) left untouched - optional and out of this feature's required scope.
